question.text: What is the 'Aggregate Escrow Demat Account' opened by an AIF used for?

answer.text: Parking uninvested fund corpus before drawdown
Holding demat units for existing investors who have not provided their demat account details
Holding sponsor commitment units before lock-in

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 115, the Aggregate Escrow Demat Account is opened solely to hold demat units for existing investors who have not yet provided their demat account details; no other transfer is permitted, and the units are transferred out to the investors' demat accounts within 5 working days once details are furnished. The Trap: Parking uninvested corpus, collecting performance fees, or holding sponsor commitment units are not the purpose of this account — it has a single, narrowly defined use. Note: Treat the 5-working-day transfer-out window as the operating rule once an investor furnishes demat details.
